data.title: Icon
data.tagline: A small, consistent visual symbol for an action, object, or status
data.description: Familiar icons such as search, download, and close help people scan quickly. For an unfamiliar or high-risk action, add text or a Tooltip.

distinctions.label: Image
distinctions.explanation: Icon is a small reusable symbol for a function or concept. Image displays a photo, illustration, or content itself.

distinctions.label: Button
distinctions.explanation: Icon communicates meaning. It becomes an icon button only when placed in a Button that runs an action.

avoid: An unfamiliar action with only an icon
Unrelated dangerous actions mixed under More
Emoji in place of consistent system icons

lessonPractice.title: A compact toolbar contains an irreversible Permanently delete project action, and new users may not know its icon. How should it be expressed?

options.label: Put a consistent icon in the action button and also show the text Permanently delete
options.feedback: The icon aids scanning, the text removes ambiguity for an unfamiliar high-risk action, and the button owns interaction.

options.label: Keep only a trash icon and reveal Permanently delete on mouse hover
options.feedback: Hover help is unavailable on touch and still requires users to guess the icon. High-risk actions need persistent meaning before activation.

options.label: Show only the trash icon and explain irreversibility in a confirmation dialog after click
options.feedback: Confirmation can prevent final mistakes but does not make the entry understandable before users activate it.

data.agentPrompt: Review the project toolbar: familiar actions may use consistent icons, but permanent deletion must also show explicit text and use a real button. Do not rely only on red or a tooltip, and verify keyboard access and the accessible name.
